question: Which of the following statements is true ?:

options.opa: The automated procedure for DNA sequencing is based on the chemical break method developed by Maxam and Gilbert.
options.opb: The technique of "Northern Blot" allows the analysis of proteins separated by electrophoresis.
options.opc: Methylation of one of the bases of the target sequence protects it from breaking by the corresponding endonuclease.
options.opd: The "Southern Blot" technique combines electrophoresis and immunodiffusion.
